config.avorion_galaxy_dir_not_creatable: The Avorion galaxy folder cannot be created ({{path}}): {{reason}}
config.avorion_ini_invalid: server.ini is not a valid INI file: {{reason}}
config.avorion_line_break: Invalid value for {{key}}: line breaks would create new keys
config.avorion_must_be_stopped: Avorion has to be stopped to change its configuration: the server rewrites its server.ini on every start, so the change would be gone without a trace at the next start.
config.avorion_state_unknown: Avorion configuration not written: the state of the container cannot be determined right now ({{reason}}). On a running server the change would be lost at the next start.
config.driver_integer_expected: {{key}}: expected a whole number — {{value}} is not one. Nothing was written.
config.factorio_data_dir_not_creatable: The Factorio data directory cannot be created ({{path}}): {{reason}}
config.factorio_settings_not_an_object: server-settings.json does not contain a JSON object.
config.minecraft_invalid_entry: Invalid server.properties entry {{key}} (line breaks and '=' are not allowed in a key)
config.reforger_invalid_json: The Reforger config is not valid JSON ({{path}}): {{reason}}
config.reforger_not_an_object: The Reforger config does not contain a JSON object ({{path}}) — it is not overwritten.
config.reforger_not_initialised: The Reforger config is not initialised yet. Create the server again (auto-seed) or seed config.json by hand, then try again.
config.reforger_rcon_password_invalid: The RCON password (REFORGER_RCON_PW) must be at most 32 characters without spaces (Reforger schema); it currently has {{length}} characters.
config.reforger_unreadable: The Reforger config cannot be read ({{path}}): {{reason}}
config.registry_row_gone: Server '{{key}}' is no longer in the registry
config.valheim_control_chars: Invalid value for {{key}}: control characters are not allowed in an env variable
config.valheim_data_dir_not_creatable: The Valheim data directory cannot be created ({{path}}): {{reason}}
config.valheim_invalid_modifier: “{{value}}” is not a valid value for {{axis}}. Allowed: {{allowed}} (or empty for the default setting).
config.valheim_password_too_short: Valheim requires a join password of at least 5 characters.
config.valheim_seconds_expected: {{key}} expects a number of seconds, not {{value}}.
console.valheim_none: Valheim has no remote console: no RCON, no stdin. Moderation works through the list files, and there are no announcements.
console.vintagestory_rcon_mod_missing: Vintage Story has no remote console of its own. The console, the player list and the moderation commands need the third-party server mod “Vintage RCON”, and it is not installed on this server. The game itself runs normally without it.
moderation.avorion_whitelist_inactive: “accessListMode” is set to “{{mode}}” — the whitelist currently has NO effect. It can be switched in the configuration, which for Avorion can only be changed while the server is stopped.
moderation.reforger_ban_entry_not_found: No ban entry found for '{{username}}' (via #ban list).
moderation.reforger_ban_needs_online: Player '{{username}}' is not connected — a ban needs a player who is online.
moderation.reforger_kick_needs_online: Player '{{username}}' is not connected — a kick needs a player who is online.
moderation.valheim_last_whitelist_entry: {{value}} is the last entry of the whitelist. Emptying it would open the server to EVERYONE — an empty permittedlist.txt lets everybody in instead of nobody. To lift the access protection, delete the file on the host; to keep it, add the next permitted player first.
moderation.valheim_not_a_platform_id: {{value}} is not a platform ID. Valheim matches its lists exclusively against Steam_76561198… or the bare SteamID64 — a player name would have no effect but, as an entry, could not be told apart from one that works.
provision.vintagestory_runner_pull_faile: The Vintage Story runner image {{image}} could not be downloaded ({{reason}}). Build it on the Docker host instead: docker build -t stacks-console/vintagestory-runner:1 dashboard/images/vintagestory — then enter stacks-console/vintagestory-runner as Image and 1 as Image tag on this server's edit page and create the container again.
server.valheim_query_not_open_yet: Valheim has not opened its Steam query yet. It does so once the world is ready (log line “Opened Steam server”); for a new world that is about a minute after “Game server connected”. Check again in a minute.
world.factorio_active_save_not_removable: “{{name}}” is the save the server loads at its next start. Select another one first — otherwise it starts into a world that no longer exists.
world.factorio_save_not_found: “{{name}}” is not in the saves folder.
world.factorio_saves_unreadable: The saves folder cannot be read ({{path}}): {{reason}}
world.remove_unsupported: This game cannot remove worlds through the dashboard.
world.set_aside_failed: The save could not be moved aside: {{reason}}
world.set_aside_nothing_found: Not a single file of this save was there — nothing was touched.
world.switch_unsupported: This game cannot switch worlds through the dashboard.
world.valheim_active_world_not_removable: “{{name}}” is the configured world. Select another one first — otherwise the server creates a NEW, empty world under this name at its next start, and that looks like data loss.
world.valheim_world_not_found: “{{name}}” is not in the worlds folder.
world.valheim_worlds_unreadable: The worlds folder cannot be read ({{path}}): {{reason}}
